Voice Announcements

Teachers and the Web Developer can record or upload their own voice clips for shared announcement events. Recordings are stored in Faraday Tech so other signed-in users can hear them.

Manage shared voice clips
Microphone recording requires browser permission and HTTPS. A new recording replaces the selected event's current clip.
